svg.text: For the Open Innovation theme, Petal Season is a slow, romantic face for people who binge love stories: blossoms frame
the date and petals drift past a large stacked serif clock against a dusk-pink sky. The stacked Libre Baskerville time
keeps glanceability high while the warm gradient and soft motion keep it calm, and the complication carries your
episode or a gentle nudge. Always-on reduces it to grey type on true black.
368 × 448 rectangular OLED · text ≥ 21 px · icons ≥ 25 px · always-on on true black · all names fictional, no logos · Designed by Amritha S
